label: Mic
depicts: Classic microphone capsule above one curved stand frame and one lower stem
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic upright microphone with a curved stand frame beneath it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the grille microphone when horizontal grille bars should appear inside the head.

label: Mic
depicts: Broadcast microphone capsule with four grille bars above one lower stand stem
use_when: Use when the interface wants a broadcast microphone with visible grille bars inside the head.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain capsule microphone when the head should stay smooth and unlined.

label: Mountain
depicts: Single mountain peak with one centered snowcap above a flat ground line
use_when: Use when the interface wants one mountain peak with a snowcap centered near the top.
avoid_when: Do not use for the double mountain icon when a second rear peak should appear at the right.

label: Mountain
depicts: Two mountain shapes with one front snowcap and one smaller right peak
use_when: Use when the interface wants a front mountain peak paired with a second smaller peak on the right.
avoid_when: Do not use for the single mountain when only one peak should dominate the icon.

label: News
depicts: Front page sheet with two centered text bars and one right side spine
use_when: Use when the interface wants a front page sheet with a visible right side spine attached.
avoid_when: Do not use for the stacked news sheets when a second page should appear behind the front page.
